scenario: A `then ... within` step on the same schema as the step before it — `A a1` then `A a2 within 5_s` (LGRA.8.5.2) — compiles with two distinct bindings, both interpolated.
rules_ds:
schema A scope ttl 1_h:
    ts: Time

rule r:
    A a1
    then A a2 within 5_s
->
    log info "{a1.ts} {a2.ts}"
